sources.title: Djibouti E-Government: eVisa replaces point-of-entry visa
sources.publisher: E-Government Portal / National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti’s E-Government portal says its administrative information is certified and validated by the relevant administrations; ANSIE is a public agency attached to the Presidency. Its current eVisa guidance describes electronic approval, email delivery and replacement of the point-of-entry visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Il remplace le visa délivré au point d'entrée ... l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: Djibouti National Tourist Office: entry formalities
sources.officialityEvidence: The National Tourist Office’s current entry-formalities page identifies the government eVisa website as the electronic visitor-visa channel, alongside embassy and consular visa routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les visiteurs peuvent obtenir leur visa électronique (eVisa) en soumettant leur demande en ligne.

sources.title: Djibouti Immigration eVisa: live terms and eligibility framing
sources.officialityEvidence: The live gouv.dj eVisa service says it is owned and operated by the Republic of Djibouti. Its terms describe a process for nationals of foreign countries whose entry is subject to a visa, but do not publish which nationalities or passport classes that includes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: This website is owned and operated by the Republic of Djibouti; it informs nationals of any foreign country subject to a visa.

sources.title: Law No. 201/AN/07/5ème L: entry and stay conditions
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Journal publishes the entry-and-stay law. It sets the foreigner entry baseline subject to international conventions, bilateral agreements and special regimes, without a passport-nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les étrangers sont ... soumis aux dispositions de la présente Loi, sous réserve des conventions internationales et des accords bilatéraux.
